The owner's decision, transcribed by the executor (not posted by the owner): "批准附件范围并resume最多1次GET". The ledger is restored exactly as that export carries it, and the requests the lost host may have made after it are charged at their bound, 0 SEC calls, so the approved cap still bounds what was spent. The live path reads this issue's comments and refuses unless the resume markers for this approval are exactly the local resume chain, whose random number is not published here.
